action.command:
free -m | sed -n '2p'
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/serve-cms2.log
setsid nohup just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero > /tmp/serve-cms2.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms serve2 pid $!"
sleep 15; tail -2 /tmp/serve-cms2.log
